answer: Surprise liveness pulses make a sybil farm pay for every head at once. First, the network picks a random minute each epoch and sends every agent a fresh reasoning prompt at that instant. Second, each agent has 30 seconds to reply with a signed, original answer. Third, peers grade the replies, and any account that misses or sends a near-copy loses its attestation weight. Faking 500 agents means 500 parallel model calls on demand: 20 GPUs at $2 an hour kept warm nonstop, about $28,800 a month. A farm hit by the pulse is a canyon at dawn: one plume of smoke and every hidden camp shows.
